title: Retry keeps execution and attachment identities distinct
canonical_summary: Replacement creates a new session and invocation card; same-session rerun preserves session identity and creates a fresh invocation/block/card; recovery and presentation changes do not replay execution.
gui_classification_reason: User-visible cards, retained output and copy behavior are directly affected; storage portion is consumed separately by SP-125.
negative_constraints: No invented liveness, successful completion, exact command attribution or lost history.
No blanket invalidation on ordinary resize.
